question.text: For a AI use case involving AI data centers, where would Vector Network Analyzer fit in the test workflow?

exchange.sent: For a AI use case involving AI data centers, where would Vector Network Analyzer fit in the test workflow?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
For an AI data center / AI server use case, a Vector Network Analyzer fits mainly in the high-speed signal-integrity workflow: PCB / PCBA IL and TDR, high-speed trace testing, cable / connector testing, network-switch VNA testing, and optical VNA work for silicon photonics; it also appears generically as “network analyzers” in the PDN test block, but the passages do not provide a specific VNA setup for PDN.[5][11][35][91]
### Where it fits in the workflow
| Workflow area | Where VNA fits | Supported test items |
|---|---|---|
| PCB material / stackup / SI workflow | R&S PCB test flow covers material measurement, material / stackup selection, signal-integrity modeling/testing, sampling testing, and process monitoring for PCB fabricator and system house workflows.[2] | The same PCB flow lists impedance / TDR and DK/DF extraction at material measurement; IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and eye diagram at material / stackup selection; and IL, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance in SI modeling/testing.[19] |
| AI server PCB / server board | In the AI server ecosystem mapping, R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB are mapped to server PCB IL and TDR testing.[11] | The same mapping says R&S ZNA and R&S ZNB are placed in server circuit board / PCB IL and TDR, and R&S ZNA also appears in server motherboard / PCBA high-speed trace testing.[35] |
| PCBA / motherboard high-speed traces | R&S ZNA is mapped to high-speed trace test for server motherboard / PCBA.[11] | The AISeverEcosystem summary says the server motherboard / PCBA R&S Solution column lists R&S ZNA for high speed trace test.[91] |
| Cable / connector interconnects | R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB plus OSP are mapped to high-speed cable testing for connector / cable categories.[11] | The AISeverEcosystem summary says the connector / cable category lists R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB + OSP for high speed cable.[91] |
| Network switch | The network-switch category lists VNA, specifically R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB, alongside R&S FSWP jitter / phase-noise test and EMI pretest.[11] | The AISeverEcosystem summary also says the network-switch category lists VNA with R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB.[91] |
| Silicon photonics / optical interconnect | The silicon photonics category lists optical VNA using R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB + PSA with ThinkLands, and R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB + GOCA with Newkey.[11] | The AISeverEcosystem summary says the silicon-photonics R&S Solution column lists optical VNA with R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB plus the named companion solutions.[91] |
| PDN / power integrity block | The SerDes / SI / PI overview places “Network Analyzers” in the Power Distribution Network test block.[5] | The AI server mapping separately lists R&S ZNL for PDN Target Z, while MXO is mapped to power rail / multiphase DC / PI.[36] |
### Key limitation
The PCB test-flow source does not provide formal R&S product models, option codes, test frequency, standards, fixtures, or calibration methods for the PCB workflow, so the VNA placement is supported as a workflow / solution-mapping fit rather than a complete validated test configuration.[20]

- Acquisition time per point：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog wideband 時 1 µs；30 MHz measurement bandwidth 時 32 ns。
- Linear frequency sweep 條件 201 points、10 GHz center frequency、200 MHz span：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog normal 時 time per sweep < 3.9 ms；sweep cycle time < 4.9 ms。
- IEC/IEEE VXI11 over 1 Gbit/s LAN：201 measurement points、800 MHz start frequency、1 GHz stop frequency、1 MHz measurement bandwidth 的 measurement and data transfer time 為 14 ms / 13 ms；201 measurement points magnitude 的 data transfer time 為 1.7 ms / 0.9 ms。
- Switching time between channels with a maximum of 2001 points：< 2 ms。
- Continuous mode 不需要額外 data transfer time，因為 data transfer 與 measurement 同時進行。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。
- Speed example：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。

R&S ZNA › 2-port / 4-port 架構
依 [[ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400]]（Version 24.00, April 2026）：

- 4-port instruments：最多 4 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 5 source 可作為 LO supply。
- 2-port instruments：最多 2 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 3 source 可作為 LO supply。
- 4-port model 每 port 有 2 true receivers，總計 8 true receivers；2-port model 每 port 有 2 true receivers，總計 4 true receivers；來源明確說明無 multiplexing。
- 支援 true parallel and coherent data acquisition，例如 antenna array tests 與 antenna test systems，從 100 kHz 開始。
- Optional rear panel LO out 可支援 mmWave converters；4-port model 最多 4 個 converters，2-port model 最多 2 個 converters，無需 external signal generator。
- Rear panel LO out 提供 high-power LO signal，typ. +25 dBm，最高 26.5 GHz，可作為 mixer measurements 的 LO source。
- Optional second LO source 可讓 mixer/frequency convertor measurements 速度加倍並最佳化 trace noise。
- 使用 [[R&S ZNA-K9]] option、1 kHz measurement bandwidth 時，mixer group delay 與 deviation from linear phase 的 group delay trace noise peak-to-peak 可由 200 ps 降至 15 ps。
- 最多 4 pulse modulators、最多 8 pulse generators（4-port）；最多 2 pulse modulators、最多 4 pulse generators（2-port）。
- Minimum pulse width：40 ns。
- Optional direct IF access（in/out）：IF input 可用於 mmWave converter 與 antenna measurement systems，bandwidth 1 GHz；IF output up to 2 GHz bandwidth 可用於 external pulse analysis。
- Selectable reference signal access：1 GHz external reference，可同步 external equipment，例如 signal generators，改善 mmWave converters up to terahertz frequencies 的 performance。

DCP-Config-r16 › 來源列出的相關欄位
[[Wake Up Signal]] 在描述 [[DCI format 2_6]] 時列出多個與 DCP / WUS 相關的 r16 欄位或參數：

- `ps-RNTI-r16`：對應 [[PS-RNTI]]。
- `ps-Offset-r16`：來源文字為 `ps-Offset-r16*0.125ms`，與 WUS search space relative to on-duration DRX cycle 的 timing 有關。
- `duration`：來源說 search space spans `duration` slots。
- `sizeDCI-2-6-r16`：DCI2_6 total length。
- `outsideActiveTimeConfig-r16`：for each UE defines the starting position of its bits inside the whole DCI。
- `ps-WakeUp-r16`：UE does not detect DCI 時的 default behavior，wake up 或 stay asleep。
- `ps-TransmitPeriodicL1CSI-r16`：on-duration cycle does not start 時仍可 transmit periodic L1-RSRP reports 的設定線索。
- `ps-TransmitOtherPeriodicCSI-r16`：on-duration cycle does not start 時仍可 transmit other periodic CSI reports 的設定線索。

OneWeb UT 測試流程 › 第一階段：實驗室 RF 測試（第 1–3 個月）
[[oneweb_ut_final_presentation]] 將第 1–3 個月定義為 laboratory RF test，主要活動包含：

- 選定終端機型號，例如 [[Intellian OW11F]] 或 [[Hughes HL1120W]]。
- 量測 RF characteristics：接收增益 / G/T、noise figure（NF）、transmit power。
- 驗證 link equation，來源以 [[Qorvo]] PA + [[Analog Devices]] LNA 作為例子。
- 分析 modulation / coding，來源寫 OneWeb proprietary 或 [[MediaTek M80]] 5G NTN modem。
- 測試設備列為 `Rohde & Schwarz SMW6` signal generator 與 [[R&S FSW]] spectrum analyzer。

交付物包含 G/T and noise figure measurement validation、Ku / Ka rain fade margin calculation 與 multipath fading assessment。

R&S FSW › 共通規格條件
- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時、warm-up operation 30 分鐘、符合指定 environmental conditions、遵守 recommended calibration interval，且若適用已完成 internal automatic adjustments。
- Frequency resolution：0.01 Hz。
- Recommended calibration interval：1 year。
- Operating temperature range：+5 °C to +50 °C。
- Permissible temperature range：0 °C to +55 °C。
- Storage temperature range：–40 °C to +70 °C。
- Display：30.7 cm WXGA color touchscreen，1280 × 800 pixel。
- Internal data storage：standard solid state disk ≥ 128 Gbyte。
- AC input voltage range：100 V to 240 V；AC supply frequency：50 Hz to 60 Hz / 400 Hz。

### Short answer
For an AI data center / AI server use case, a Vector Network Analyzer fits mainly in the high-speed signal-integrity workflow: PCB / PCBA IL and TDR, high-speed trace testing, cable / connector testing, network-switch VNA testing, and optical VNA work for silicon photonics; it also appears generically as “network analyzers” in the PDN test block, but the passages do not provide a specific VNA setup for PDN.[5][11][35][91]
### Where it fits in the workflow
| Workflow area | Where VNA fits | Supported test items |
|---|---|---|
| PCB material / stackup / SI workflow | R&S PCB test flow covers material measurement, material / stackup selection, signal-integrity modeling/testing, sampling testing, and process monitoring for PCB fabricator and system house workflows.[2] | The same PCB flow lists impedance / TDR and DK/DF extraction at material measurement; IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and eye diagram at material / stackup selection; and IL, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance in SI modeling/testing.[19] |
| AI server PCB / server board | In the AI server ecosystem mapping, R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB are mapped to server PCB IL and TDR testing.[11] | The same mapping says R&S ZNA and R&S ZNB are placed in server circuit board / PCB IL and TDR, and R&S ZNA also appears in server motherboard / PCBA high-speed trace testing.[35] |
| PCBA / motherboard high-speed traces | R&S ZNA is mapped to high-speed trace test for server motherboard / PCBA.[11] | The AISeverEcosystem summary says the server motherboard / PCBA R&S Solution column lists R&S ZNA for high speed trace test.[91] |
| Cable / connector interconnects | R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB plus OSP are mapped to high-speed cable testing for connector / cable categories.[11] | The AISeverEcosystem summary says the connector / cable category lists R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB + OSP for high speed cable.[91] |
| Network switch | The network-switch category lists VNA, specifically R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB, alongside R&S FSWP jitter / phase-noise test and EMI pretest.[11] | The AISeverEcosystem summary also says the network-switch category lists VNA with R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB.[91] |
| Silicon photonics / optical interconnect | The silicon photonics category lists optical VNA using R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB + PSA with ThinkLands, and R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB + GOCA with Newkey.[11] | The AISeverEcosystem summary says the silicon-photonics R&S Solution column lists optical VNA with R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB plus the named companion solutions.[91] |
| PDN / power integrity block | The SerDes / SI / PI overview places “Network Analyzers” in the Power Distribution Network test block.[5] | The AI server mapping separately lists R&S ZNL for PDN Target Z, while MXO is mapped to power rail / multiphase DC / PI.[36] |
### Key limitation
The PCB test-flow source does not provide formal R&S product models, option codes, test frequency, standards, fixtures, or calibration methods for the PCB workflow, so the VNA placement is supported as a workflow / solution-mapping fit rather than a complete validated test configuration.[20]

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。
- Speed example：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。

R&S ZNA › 2-port / 4-port 架構
依 [[ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400]]（Version 24.00, April 2026）：

- 4-port instruments：最多 4 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 5 source 可作為 LO supply。
- 2-port instruments：最多 2 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 3 source 可作為 LO supply。
- 4-port model 每 port 有 2 true receivers，總計 8 true receivers；2-port model 每 port 有 2 true receivers，總計 4 true receivers；來源明確說明無 multiplexing。
- 支援 true parallel and coherent data acquisition，例如 antenna array tests 與 antenna test systems，從 100 kHz 開始。
- Optional rear panel LO out 可支援 mmWave converters；4-port model 最多 4 個 converters，2-port model 最多 2 個 converters，無需 external signal generator。
- Rear panel LO out 提供 high-power LO signal，typ. +25 dBm，最高 26.5 GHz，可作為 mixer measurements 的 LO source。
- Optional second LO source 可讓 mixer/frequency convertor measurements 速度加倍並最佳化 trace noise。
- 使用 [[R&S ZNA-K9]] option、1 kHz measurement bandwidth 時，mixer group delay 與 deviation from linear phase 的 group delay trace noise peak-to-peak 可由 200 ps 降至 15 ps。
- 最多 4 pulse modulators、最多 8 pulse generators（4-port）；最多 2 pulse modulators、最多 4 pulse generators（2-port）。
- Minimum pulse width：40 ns。
- Optional direct IF access（in/out）：IF input 可用於 mmWave converter 與 antenna measurement systems，bandwidth 1 GHz；IF output up to 2 GHz bandwidth 可用於 external pulse analysis。
- Selectable reference signal access：1 GHz external reference，可同步 external equipment，例如 signal generators，改善 mmWave converters up to terahertz frequencies 的 performance。

DCP-Config-r16 › 來源列出的相關欄位
[[Wake Up Signal]] 在描述 [[DCI format 2_6]] 時列出多個與 DCP / WUS 相關的 r16 欄位或參數：

- `ps-RNTI-r16`：對應 [[PS-RNTI]]。
- `ps-Offset-r16`：來源文字為 `ps-Offset-r16*0.125ms`，與 WUS search space relative to on-duration DRX cycle 的 timing 有關。
- `duration`：來源說 search space spans `duration` slots。
- `sizeDCI-2-6-r16`：DCI2_6 total length。
- `outsideActiveTimeConfig-r16`：for each UE defines the starting position of its bits inside the whole DCI。
- `ps-WakeUp-r16`：UE does not detect DCI 時的 default behavior，wake up 或 stay asleep。
- `ps-TransmitPeriodicL1CSI-r16`：on-duration cycle does not start 時仍可 transmit periodic L1-RSRP reports 的設定線索。
- `ps-TransmitOtherPeriodicCSI-r16`：on-duration cycle does not start 時仍可 transmit other periodic CSI reports 的設定線索。

### Short answer
For an AI data center / AI server use case, a Vector Network Analyzer fits mainly in the high-speed signal-integrity workflow: PCB / PCBA IL and TDR, high-speed trace testing, cable / connector testing, network-switch VNA testing, and optical VNA work for silicon photonics; it also appears generically as “network analyzers” in the PDN test block, but the passages do not provide a specific VNA setup for PDN.[5][11][35][91]
### Where it fits in the workflow
| Workflow area | Where VNA fits | Supported test items |
|---|---|---|
| PCB material / stackup / SI workflow | R&S PCB test flow covers material measurement, material / stackup selection, signal-integrity modeling/testing, sampling testing, and process monitoring for PCB fabricator and system house workflows.[2] | The same PCB flow lists impedance / TDR and DK/DF extraction at material measurement; IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and eye diagram at material / stackup selection; and IL, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance in SI modeling/testing.[19] |
| AI server PCB / server board | In the AI server ecosystem mapping, R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB are mapped to server PCB IL and TDR testing.[11] | The same mapping says R&S ZNA and R&S ZNB are placed in server circuit board / PCB IL and TDR, and R&S ZNA also appears in server motherboard / PCBA high-speed trace testing.[35] |
| PCBA / motherboard high-speed traces | R&S ZNA is mapped to high-speed trace test for server motherboard / PCBA.[11] | The AISeverEcosystem summary says the server motherboard / PCBA R&S Solution column lists R&S ZNA for high speed trace test.[91] |
| Cable / connector interconnects | R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB plus OSP are mapped to high-speed cable testing for connector / cable categories.[11] | The AISeverEcosystem summary says the connector / cable category lists R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB + OSP for high speed cable.[91] |
| Network switch | The network-switch category lists VNA, specifically R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB, alongside R&S FSWP jitter / phase-noise test and EMI pretest.[11] | The AISeverEcosystem summary also says the network-switch category lists VNA with R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB.[91] |
| Silicon photonics / optical interconnect | The silicon photonics category lists optical VNA using R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB + PSA with ThinkLands, and R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB + GOCA with Newkey.[11] | The AISeverEcosystem summary says the silicon-photonics R&S Solution column lists optical VNA with R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB plus the named companion solutions.[91] |
| PDN / power integrity block | The SerDes / SI / PI overview places “Network Analyzers” in the Power Distribution Network test block.[5] | The AI server mapping separately lists R&S ZNL for PDN Target Z, while MXO is mapped to power rail / multiphase DC / PI.[36] |
### Key limitation
The PCB test-flow source does not provide formal R&S product models, option codes, test frequency, standards, fixtures, or calibration methods for the PCB workflow, so the VNA placement is supported as a workflow / solution-mapping fit rather than a complete validated test configuration.[20]
